name: POST to CIM
info:
Creates a new CIM case from a bridge entry.

### Input
Msg after Bridge to CIM:
- `msg.metadata` — entry metadata (source/target/connection_name)
- `msg.payload`  — `{ subject, description, source, reported_date }` (registration schema, flat).

### Logic
1. Build URL `{base_url}/cases` and Bearer headers from `target.client_specific`.
2. POST JSON body. Body must conform to the registration schema (additionalProperties:false, only `subject` is required).
3. Return response: `msg.result = true` on 200/201, else `false`.

### Output
POST response (msg.result set by Return response).
